name: Weekly digests
description: One digest per week for leadership: which projects the team saw, what was found, and what needs following up.

body.en: Read the `busa-dealflow` skill in this folder, then the `dealflow-weekly-digest` skill, and follow them. Write the digest for Monday to Sunday of this week: the projects the team saw, the key findings, stage changes, and the follow-ups that are overdue or due next week. Every line must trace to a meeting or follow-up record.
body.zh-CN: 先阅读本文件夹里的 `busa-dealflow` Skill，再读 `dealflow-weekly-digest` Skill，按它们的流程做。为本周一到周日写一份周报：团队看了哪些项目、关键发现、阶段变化、逾期和下周到期的待跟进。每一条都要能对应到会议或待跟进记录。

body.en: Read the `busa-dealflow` skill in this folder, then the `dealflow-weekly-digest` skill, and follow them. From the latest digest, give me five lines: the headline, the two most important findings, the follow-up most at risk, and the one decision leadership needs to make. Reply in chat; do not change the digest.
body.zh-CN: 先阅读本文件夹里的 `busa-dealflow` Skill，再读 `dealflow-weekly-digest` Skill，按它们的流程做。基于最新一份周报，给我五行：一句话结论、最重要的两个发现、最可能延误的一条跟进、需要管理层拍板的一件事。直接回复在对话里，不要改周报。
